response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years of experience, but their profile is heavily oriented toward web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than the role's core requirement of hands-on modern C++ development. C++ exposure is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments (2014–2015) and a university thesis project. There is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL secure development practices, MQTT/industrial protocols, or industrial automation domain experience, making the fit for this specific role poor despite general seniority.
strengths: Deep experience with high-performance, low-latency systems (async I/O, fibers, caching at millions of requests/sec)
Strong software craftsmanship practices: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
Broad polyglot background including event-driven and distributed architectures
concerns: Minimal and dated professional C++ experience (~6 months in 2014–2015)
No industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443), SDL, or industrial protocol (Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT) experience
No industrial automation or IoT domain background; career trajectory points toward web/cloud product work

key_factors.factor: No industrial automation / IEC 62443 security background
